Functional Requirement: The system shall allow a new user to register as either a Buyer or a Seller.
The system shall reject incomplete or duplicate registration.
The system shall authenticate users and redirect by role.
The system shall return a generic invalid-login error.
The system shall allow logged-in users to log out.
The system shall allow users to edit permitted account information.
The system shall allow sellers to create complete listings with optional images.
The system shall validate ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 checksums.
The system shall place new/materially edited listings into pending review.
Additional Comments: Title/author/description/ISBN edits return approved or rejected listings to pending and notify admins with the changed fields; price/stock edits stay live; pending listings cannot be checked out from carts

Functional Requirement: The system shall allow sellers to edit their own listings.
Additional Comments: Inline edit form in My listings warns before a change that triggers admin re-review

Functional Requirement: The system shall allow sellers to remove their own listings.
The system shall label and prevent purchase of zero-stock listings.
The system shall restrict seller listing actions to their own listings.
The system shall show pending listings ordered by submission date.
The system shall publish approved listings.
The system shall reject listings with a reason.
The system shall notify sellers of moderation decisions.
The system shall flag prohibited words/phrases.
The system shall block approval of invalid ISBNs.
The system shall search published listings by title author genre or ISBN.
The system shall sort results alphabetically by title.
The system shall show a no-results message.
The system shall allow browse by genre.
The system shall display complete listing details.
The system shall exclude non-published listings from search/browse.
The system shall allow in-stock published products in a cart.
The system shall allow cart view/removal and subtotal updates.
The system shall require login before checkout.
The system shall display an itemized order summary before payment.
Additional Comments: Two-step checkout: details then a separate review step listing each item (author qty unit price line total) subtotal state tax store credit card amount ship-to address and payment method; unavailable or short-stock items are flagged; checkout refuses if the total changed since review

Functional Requirement: The system shall decrement stock and create a permanent order.
The system shall allow eligible return requests.
Additional Comments: Implemented as a local return/refund request within REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS (see REQ-035); physical-return logistics remain deferred

Functional Requirement: The system shall reject expired return requests.
Additional Comments: Configurable REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS (default 30) from order date; enforced atomically on insert; UI hides expired requests

Functional Requirement: The system shall require a refund reason.
The system shall notify relevant sellers of refund requests.
Additional Comments: Each seller on the order is notified about only their own items in the same transaction as the request; sellers not on the order are not notified

Functional Requirement: The system shall refund approved requests and mark orders refunded.
The system shall notify buyers of refund decisions.
The system shall show sellers their own order items and buyer shipping data.
The system shall allow processing and shipping with tracking.
The system shall notify buyers when orders ship.
The system shall allow unshipped cancellation and refund.
Additional Comments: Per-item cancellation refunds item price plus tax and restocks in one transaction; spent store credit is returned first and the rest is recorded locally as an original-payment refund without a provider; order is cancelled once every item is cancelled

Functional Requirement: The system shall notify buyers of cancellation reasons.
The system shall allow reviews only for delivered purchases.
The system shall prevent duplicate reviews.
The system shall screen reviews for prohibited content.
The system shall reject prohibited reviews with an explanation.
The system shall require a star rating.
The system shall show average and individual reviews.
Additional Comments: Book detail shows the average rating (one decimal) and review count above the individual reviews (newest first); no-review books show No ratings yet

Functional Requirement: The system shall allow buyers to add books to wishlists.
The system shall reject duplicate wishlist entries.
The system shall display all saved wishlist books.
The system shall allow wishlist removal with confirmation.
The system shall mark unavailable saved books without deleting them.
The system shall allow buyers to compare two to four approved listings using key attributes.
The system shall allow buyers to set whole-number quantities subject to available stock.
Additional Comments: Validated in cart and buy-now checkout

Functional Requirement: The system shall calculate and persist tax using the checkout state and order request IP audit metadata.
Additional Comments: Trusted IP_STATE_MAP may override the selected state; public IP geolocation is deferred

Functional Requirement: The system shall provide a role-aware homepage that routes users to their dashboard.
Additional Comments: Buyer seller and administrator routes are supported

Functional Requirement: The system shall show seller gross sales items sold order count and per-listing earnings in a dedicated dashboard/profile area.
Additional Comments: Cancelled and refunded orders are excluded from gross sales; cart badge is documented in the frontend scope

Functional Requirement: The system shall allow administrators to override eligible order statuses and audit the action.
Additional Comments: Buyer notification and admin_actions audit entry are created

Functional Requirement: The system shall provide admin seller and buyer inboxes for supervision messages buyer requests wishlist interest and order notifications.
Additional Comments: Unread navigation badge and read-state updates are included

Functional Requirement: The system shall process approved refunds to store credit or the original payment method and notify affected roles.
Additional Comments: Store credit is applied locally; original-payment processing is recorded locally without a provider

Functional Requirement: The system shall show buyers their current BookHaven store-credit balance and allow them to choose store credit or original payment as a refund destination.
Additional Comments: The balance is read from the database and refreshed when the buyer page loads

Functional Requirement: The system shall allow buyers to apply available store credit to cart checkout and pay any remaining balance by card.
Additional Comments: Checkout deducts credit atomically and records the credit and remaining card amounts

Technical Assumption(s) and/or Customer: Admins need an operational control center
Functional Requirement: The system shall provide administrators with a distinct control center for moderation account governance refund decisions and safety commands instead of buyer storefront navigation.
Additional Comments: Admin order detail browsing was removed from the dashboard; operational order status API remains available for controlled intervention

Functional Requirement: The system shall provide sellers with a clear workspace for earnings catalog management fulfillment actions and refund decisions without buyer storefront panels.
Additional Comments: Seller navigation exposes one inbox and seller workspace
